lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Sorte (lucky, chance, coincidence, by accident, fortunately), sufixos que formam adjetivos e advérbios (-ful, -less, -ous, -ly).

aula.text: **Sufixos que formam adjetivos e advérbios:** -ful (careful = cuidadoso, successful = bem-sucedido), -less (careless = descuidado, hopeless = sem esperança), -ous (dangerous = perigoso), -y (lucky = sortudo, windy = ventoso), -ly (luckily = felizmente, carefully = com cuidado).

items: "It was a casualty that we met in Paris." *Casualty* é vítima. O certo é **It was a coincidence.**
"I lost the bus this morning." O certo é **I missed the bus.**

exercises.prompt: We met by ___ at the airport. We didn't plan it.
___, nobody was hurt in the accident.
It was a casualty that we met in Paris.
acc: It was a coincidence that we met in Paris

exercises.prompt: I lost the bus this morning.
acc: I missed the bus this morning

chat.role: Amiga que reage e pede detalhes.
chat.goal: 5 palavras da aula e 2 palavras formadas com sufixo.

lessons.title: Third conditional
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Third conditional (if + past perfect, would have + particípio).

head: Estrutura
Uso
Exemplo
rows: If + past perfect, would have + particípio
situação imaginária no passado, que não aconteceu
If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.
If she had studied, she might have passed.
What would you have done if you had won?

aula.text: A forma curta *'d* serve para os dois: *If I'd known, I'd have called.* (had depois de if, would depois do sujeito)
**Regra de ouro:** nunca use *would* logo depois de if.

items: "If I would have known, I would have called." O certo é **If I had known, I would have called.**
"If I had known, I would called." O certo é **would have called.**
"If we have taken a taxi..." O certo é **If we had taken a taxi...**

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (leave) earlier, I ___ (not miss) the bus.
What ___ you ___ (do) if you ___ (win) the lottery last year?
If I would have known, I would have called you.
acc: If I had known, I would have called you
If I had known, I'd have called you

exercises.prompt: If I had known, I would called you.
acc: If I had known, I would have called you
If I had known, I'd have called you

exercises.prompt: If we have taken a taxi, we would have arrived on time.
acc: If we had taken a taxi, we would have arrived on time

lessons.title: Inglês prático, lamentar e consolar
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Lamentar e consolar.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: What a shame! / What bad luck! / I'm so sorry to hear that. / That's a pity.
Don't worry. / It could have been worse. / These things happen. / Better luck next time.
At least nobody was hurt. / The good thing is... / Look on the bright side.

items: "I feel it that you lost your job." O certo é **I'm so sorry to hear that.**
"Don't worry, is normal." O certo é **it's normal** ou **These things happen.** (o *it* é obrigatório)

acc: I'm so sorry to hear that you lost your job
I am so sorry to hear that you lost your job
do not worry, it is normal
